definitions.explanation: An injury to body tissue caused by a blow or impact, resulting in discoloration and swelling without breaking the skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打撲|だぼく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I fell and bruised my knee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧⟦では→では：noentry⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧{打撲|だぼく}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The diagnosis showed it was a bruise, not a fracture.

examples.japanese: {打撲|だぼく}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{内出血|ないしゅっけつ}→内出血：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: Internal bleeding from the bruise can be seen.

notes:
{打撲|だぼく} refers to a bruise or contusion from blunt impact. The verb form is {打撲|だぼく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {打撲傷|だぼくしょう}: bruise injury
- {打撲|だぼく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧: to sustain a bruise
- ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧{打撲|だぼく}: mild bruise
- ⟦{全身|ぜんしん}→全身：03313_zenshin⟧{打撲|だぼく}: full-body bruising

SYMPTOMS:
- {腫|は}れ: swelling
- {内出血|ないしゅっけつ}: internal bleeding
- ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧: pain
- {変色|へんしょく}: discoloration

CASUAL EQUIVALENT:
In everyday speech, ⟦あざ→あざ：18828_aza⟧ (bruise mark) or {青|あお}あざ (blue bruise) are more common than the medical term {打撲|だぼく}.
